events.subtitle: The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Concert — Tokyo opening performance
events.category: Japanese game music / bespoke orchestral anniversary
events.factual_description: Promax presents the Tokyo opening of the Zelda anniversary orchestral series on January 23, 2027, at 13:00; doors open at 12:00. The Hyrule Symphony Orchestra is assembled around musicians who played the games’ background music. The Japanese series returns to an audience-attended orchestral format after 2018. Official seat categories are JPY 11,000, 14,300 and 16,500.
